label: D0028-research-price-total
prompt:
Use web_fetch to open the live catalog. Choose five distinct in-stock Christmas gifts for a software club in catalog order. Give the exact product title linked to its exact product page and the listed price with its currency for every gift. Use five short sentences, one per gift, with no table or list. After each price state the running subtotal for one unit of each gift listed so far, excluding shipping and tax. Put the subtotal on the same line as its gift link, using the words Subtotal USD followed by the amount to two decimal places.
https://mercantile.wordpress.org/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=8&stock_status=instock&_fields=name,permalink,prices&_run=ea7c785c
publication_timing: Public plan commit created at export time; use the source plan mapping for original chronology.
